task.title: Project lifecycle traces into graph views
task.summary: Make generated graph/status/resume views consume lifecycle traces and catalog refs as trace-DAG projections with compact pointer-based expansion.

goal.outcome: Generated graph views expose trace-DAG lifecycle status, blockers, decision queue, task/path indexes, and exact JSON pointers for token-efficient agents.
acceptance: Graph primary records represent traces without redundant artifact node identity in the trace-primary views.
Views include at least status/resume/decision-queue/lineage/task/path/blockers compatibility outputs or explicit deferred evidence for any view not implemented in this slice.
Cold trace catalog refs can appear as `git:<commit_sha>:<path>#<pointer>` without forcing full hydration.
Runtime state remains a hot coordination input and is projected into runtime/readiness views without becoming durable trace truth.
Existing graph lens tests pass or are updated to assert trace-primary behavior.
non_goals: Do not implement optional SQLite cache unless needed for tests.
Do not migrate all source roots to decision/planning/implementation.
Do not delete legacy graph fields before compatibility consumers are updated.

validation.reason: Implementation validation must not reuse builder thought context and must cite checked content proof.

next_loop.reason: The next gateway must independently validate implementation evidence and cite checked content proof.
